rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only recovery student needs independent naturally occurring TRAIN recovery cells in addition to induced direction-balanced labels.
observable_information: Four-frame pixels and inherited action at unpulsed low-visibility intervention; simulator geometry is restricted to TRAIN teacher steering labels.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Collect and hash unpulsed natural TRAIN recovery episodes without changing the underlying bend-rebound pixel controller outside teacher intervention.
expected_success_endpoint: All 96 fresh TRAIN episodes valid, at least four new natural recovery cells across two tracks with both steering signs represented, zero invalid actions.
control: Exact bend-rebound ZIP SHA-256 8f7e87c29e92caf49db0070842dbc30f21a20ff98a3f48bf17d9599490559e49 as inherited driver, no pulse arm.
falsifier: Invalid data/hash/action, missing denominator, fewer than four natural recovery cells, fewer than two tracks, or missing either steering sign.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Fresh TRAIN tracks 1-3 x seeds 5260-5291, 96 unpulsed teacher-only episodes with per-cell hashed labels.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU collection capped at 3,600 seconds, two cores, 2 GiB and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
